question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Is he ready to risk his __acredation__ for the greater good?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"accredation"** is incorrect as it does not exist in standard English vocabulary. (गलत)
 
• The correct word **"accreditation"** means the process of officially recognizing someone or something as having a particular status or being qualified. (प्रमाणीकरण)
 
 
• **Example:** The university received accreditation from the education board for its new program.
 
 
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** (प्रमाणीकरण)
 
 
• **Example:** विश्वविद्यालय को शिक्षा बोर्ड से अपने नए कार्यक्रम के लिए प्रमाणीकरण प्राप्त हुआ।
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 1: accredation** (गलत): Incorrect spelling of "accreditation".
 
• **Option 2: acreditation** (गलत): Another incorrect spelling of "accreditation".
 
• **Option 4: acredation** (गलत): Misspelled version of "accreditation".
